# Quotation -- Technical maintenance services, Rautavaara industrial estate (TKR-RFQ-2026-07)

**Bidder:** Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla

## 2. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA qualification (LVI- ja sahkourakointi, valid to 2027-03-31) and a valid F-gas regulation qualification (valid to 2028-01-31). The company employs 62 LVI professionals and 48 electrical professionals in its own workforce, both above the stated minimums of 20 and 15 respectively. Visakoivu Oy holds a current Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate (valid to 2026-12-31) and offers as its qualifying reference the Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue framework agreement, EUR 1,650,000, covering property maintenance and LVI upkeep at five health centres (2021-2024).

## 3. Technical requirements

**3.1 Occupational safety plan:** Operated under our NMSB 75310:2018 Tyoterveys- ja tyoturvallisuusjarjestelma, covering induction, PPE and permit-to-work procedures for work across the four-building estate.

**3.2 Warranty period:** 24 months on installed equipment and materials, from date of commissioning.

**3.3 Lift maintenance:** Statutory inspection and maintenance obligations for the estate's goods and passenger lifts met and documented through our lift-partner arrangement, with inspection certificates retained on file and made available to the Buyer.

**3.4 Waste management:** Waste generated during maintenance work sorted and managed per current regulation, coordinated with the estate's existing waste contractor.

**3.5 Spare parts:** Common parts typically available within 2-5 working days from our supplier network; for discontinued equipment, we assess equivalent-part substitution or refurbishment before proposing replacement.

**3.6 Quality control:** Inspection and sign-off for completed work under NMSB 7310:2015 (Laadunhallintajarjestelma, valid to 2027-06-30), with records retained for the contract period.

**3.7 Environmental management:** Managed under NMSB 74210:2015 (valid to 2027-06-30), covering emissions, noise and waste handling during works.

**3.8 Building envelope inspection:** Annual visual condition assessment of roofing, cladding and fabric across Halli 1-4, with a written condition report and photographic record provided to the Buyer.

**3.9 Maintenance visit scheduling:** Content and frequency of scheduled visits set per system criticality and tenant operating pattern, agreed in writing with the estate manager before the contract starts.

**3.10 Access and security:** Site access coordinated with each tenant's own security arrangements; the 48-hour notice period for tenanted areas set out in Liite A is followed except in emergency response.

**3.11 Reporting:** Maintenance activity and outstanding items reported monthly to the Buyer's facilities contact in a standard format agreed at contract start.

**3.12 Response and on-call:** Tiered response times by severity category, with 24/7 on-call cover for shared-system critical faults.

**3.13 Asset register handover:** Existing asset register and technical documentation received, verified and incorporated into our maintenance management system at contract start.

**3.14 Corrective maintenance response times:** Non-emergency requests addressed within agreed working-day windows, set out by severity category.

**3.15 Staff training:** Annual training session for the Buyer's own facilities staff on the maintained systems, plus ad-hoc briefings following equipment changes.

**3.16 Subcontracting management:** Subcontracted trades selected against our approved-supplier register, supervised by our named site lead, with the same quality and safety standards applied as to direct staff.

**3.17 Escalation:** A fault unresolved within the agreed response time is escalated to the maintenance manager, with the Buyer notified of the escalation and revised timeline.

## 4. Commercial terms

**4.1 Bonus-malus:** Proposed arrangement for over- and under-performance against agreed service levels, detailed in the pricing schedule.
**4.2 Price indexation:** Annual adjustment proposed against a published cost index, reference month to be agreed at contract signature.
**4.3 Payment terms:** Terms in this request and its annexes accepted.
**4.4 Invoicing:** Monthly invoicing, electronic invoicing capability confirmed.
**4.5 Termination:** 30 days' written notice for material breach not remedied, as set out in Liite D.
**4.6 Pricing structure:** Shared-system maintenance priced per Liite B.3 -- **EUR per square metre per year**, not per month; note that the main body is silent on the pricing unit for this scope, and B.3 governs.
**4.7 Currency:** All prices in euro.

## 5. Enclosures

Reference form (Liite 2), certificate of pension insurance payments, certificate of tax payment, and quality system description enclosed.

## 6. Format

Minimum 11pt font throughout; delivery channel and copy count stated in the covering letter; closing time noted as 16 October 2026, 14:00 Finnish time (EET/EEST as applicable); framework pricing in euro; monetary figures to two decimal places.

## Annex A -- confirmations

Personnel qualifications and site-induction requirements confirmed for all estate-based staff; method statement provided for installation work minimising tenant disruption; F-gas-regulated maintenance of refrigeration equipment confirmed under our existing qualification; HVAC maintenance scope and frequency set out per building; continuity of service maintained through cross-trained secondary staff for each discipline; periodic electrical inspection programme confirmed; fire protection testing and maintenance scheduled per building.

## Annex B -- confirmations

Discount structure for order-volume growth proposed in the pricing schedule; contractual penalty for service-level shortfall accepted in principle, terms to be finalised; pricing for shared-system maintenance quoted at EUR per square metre per year as required by B.3; quoted prices valid for 90 days from the closing date.
